Private URIs using the g prefix are pointers to the respective lemmas in the FFDB collection of glossaries. Glossaries were taken from the original text source.

body.p: Wild reindeer. There lived one old man. The old man always hunted wild reindeer, he hunted a lot. Every day he caught a lot of wild reindeer. So it was. How [DCh]: many reindeer he caught, (â¦). There was a lot of reindeer meat. The old man threw the meat away, he took The second clause is completely unclear.the fur. So it was. There is a bad day, apparently. The reindeer meat shapeshifts. Then it runs [away]. The old man again hunted wild reindeer. The reindeer devil[s] ran to the tent. They ran into the tent, they ate up all(?) the food. Than they ran again [back] there. The old man came to his tent. Then the old man saw faeces and traces. The old man strongly wants to eat (?), there is no meat.[DCh]: Form "ajawundi" is strange, not clear whether indeed The old man is hungering all the time, he was hungering and hungering, he died.2SG; the form "dÊ¼awi-" seems to be incomplete. Long ago there were many wild reindeer. Today there are no wild reindeer. A good person hunts wild reindeer. A bad person won't find wild reindeer.
